text: # KYC and Regulatory Basics for Frontline Staff **Document ID:** TRN_004 **Category:** GENERAL — Cross-Category / General **Department:** Compliance **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-05-15 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Learning Objectives - Understand the customer scenario this module covers and why it matters. - Apply the correct process steps consistently and within SLA. - Recognise when to escalate rather than continue troubleshooting. ## Core Content # KYC and Regulatory Basics for Frontline Staff **Document ID:** TRN_004 **Department:** Compliance **Category:** General (C01-C29) **Last Updated:** 2026-05-19 **Version:** 1.0 --- ## Learning Objectives Staff understand acceptable ID documents, video-KYC procedure, and consequences of KYC non-compliance. ## Acceptable Documents Aadhaar (with consent), Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence — must be original, legible, and unexpired. ## Video KYC Checklist - [ ] Liveness check completed (customer performs a random action on request) - [ ] Document held next to face, both clearly visible - [ ] Geo-tag and timestamp captured automatically - [ ] Customer consent to data processing explicitly recorded ## Consequences of Errors Incomplete or fraudulent KYC exposes the company to regulatory penalties and licence risk — never bypass a required verification step, even under customer pressure. ## Key Definitions - **SLA** — the target time within which a request or issue should be resolved. - **Escalation** — handing a case to a specialist team when first-line steps do not resolve it. ## Worked Example During a routine interaction, the agent identifies this scenario, applies the documented process,
